ModMetaData.name: Mišák Bodies
ModMetaData.author: Bolek98
ModMetaData.description:
Four new body types with visible arms: F1 BB (a fuller BB-style female), F2 soft BB, M1 muscular and M2 slim. They can be picked in the character editor, and new people get one with the chance set in the settings.
Each new body wears the clothes of its base body (FemaleBB/Female, Female, Hulk, Male). Body Fit then fits them to the new shape.
Overlays drawn by other mods (nipples, female genitals, penis) are hidden by default and can be shown in the settings.
